analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($579.60) vs SMA5/20/50 ($588.48/$591.36/$596.11) — Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weak positioning.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($607.55/$625.98) — Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (21.9%) + Approaching historical low range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (48.6 → 44.6) — Continuing in neutral zone, indicating lack of direction.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.3518 → -0.2754) — Improving, potential sign of bottoming.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower $549.76 ~ Middle $591.36) — Consolidating near the middle band, with a band width of 14.07% indicating moderate volatility.

· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low > 20-day low * 1.005 not met, 5-day high < 20-day high * 0.995 not met — confirming sideways pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.18x) — Below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Buy entry conditions not met, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
